tier1.headline: Your data is shared commercially
tier1.quote: 5 Point Solutions will not obtain personally-identifying information about you when you visit our site, unless you choose to provide such information to us, nor will such information be sold or otherwise transferred to unaffiliated third parties without the approval of the user at the time of collection.

tier2.headline: Your data transfers internationally
tier2.quote: GDPR requires that personal data from the EEA is subject to special protection.

tier2.headline: Your data shared with authorities
tier2.quote: We may disclose information when legally compelled to do so, in other words, when we, in good faith, believe that the law requires it or for the protection of our legal rights.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights are limited
tier2.quote: We will maintain the information you send via email in accordance with applicable federal law.
